name: employer_id
description: Employer key: E and the first 8 hex digits of the MD5 of the organisation's cleaned, case-folded name (docs/identifiers.md).

name: employer_name
description: The most common spelling of the organisation's name across the sources.

name: sector
description: Agreed sector (mappings/sector.csv), or Unknown when no source gives a usable value. Chosen across all of the organisation's rows: the most common value, then a specific value over Other, then source priority, then the latest row.

name: industry
description: Agreed industry (mappings/industry.csv), or Unknown when no source gives a usable value. Chosen across all of the organisation's rows: the most common value, then a specific value over Other, then source priority, then the latest row.

name: size_band
description: Agreed size band (mappings/size_band.csv), or Unknown when no source gives a usable value. Chosen across all of the organisation's rows: the most common value, then a specific value over Other, then source priority, then the latest row.

name: sites_band
description: Agreed sites band (mappings/sites_band.csv), or Unknown when no source gives a usable value. Chosen across all of the organisation's rows: the most common value, then a specific value over Other, then source priority, then the latest row.

name: in_signups
description: The organisation has a row on Account signups.

name: in_survey
description: The organisation has a survey response.

name: in_was
description: The organisation has a WAS request.

name: in_peer
description: The organisation has a peer mentoring expression of interest.

name: attribute_conflicts
description: Where the organisation's rows disagree, e.g. 'sector: Private | Public; size_band: 1000+ | 50-249'. NULL when they agree.
